title: Pay on third turn without card
description: Pay on third turn without card. Rules pressure makes exit unavoidable; paying avoids wasting the decision. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: Paying the $50 fine to get out of jail.
final_action.private_thought: I have $510 cash, fine is $50. Paying ensures I leave jail now and can start moving to develop my orange monopoly. Rolling for doubles only 1/6 chance and would waste a turn. Paying is the safe, optimal choice.

breakdown.message: Leaves a playable reserve after paying.
Chooses movement tempo over passive protection.
Private thought names why exiting matters.
